nativeSpeaker.scope: The authored Spanish prose in courses/spanish/manifest.json: lesson titles, objectives, prompts, answers, explanations and cultural notes, and the A1 tags attached to them. The Spanish starter in tests/fixtures/lesson-variety.ts ships to no learner and is outside this gate.

note: The prose review was reported as passed by the project owner. It is a review of the authored text, not of the recording: the Spanish model audio still needs the listening review in docs/human-review-gates.md.
